headline: Chinese Real Estate Stocks Plunge as New Rules on Fundraising Raise Business Risks
summary: Real estate developer stocks fell in Chinese and Hong Kong markets on the 31st after regulatory changes to the presale system for uncompleted new homes. The changes were said to worsen developers' cash flow.
why: Property developers depend on presales of unfinished homes to fund construction, so changes to those rules directly affect their liquidity. China's property sector is a major driver of its economy and of commodity demand.
